candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get fever for 2 days. E temperature na 38.0°C. E get obvious reason for the fever. E no dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E no get rash for body, e no get red eye, e no get runny nose, e no dey cough, e no get stiff neck, e no get ear problem, e no get diarrhoea, and e never get measles for the last 3 months. E no get cough wey follow measles. E no get identified bacterial cause for this fever. Malaria risk dey low. Pikin get fever.
